16.48: and stands between the dead and the living, and the plague is restrained;
16.49: and those who die by the plague are fourteen thousand and seven hundred, apart from those who die for the matter of Korah;
16.50: and Aaron turns back to Moses, to the opening of the tent of meeting, and the plague has been restrained.

17.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
17.2: `Speak to the sons of Israel, and take from them each a rod, for a father's house, from all their princes, for the house of their fathers, twelve rods; the name of each you do write on his rod,
17.3: and Aaron's name you do write on the tribe of Levi; for one rod is for the head of their fathers' house:
17.4: and you have placed them in the tent of meeting, before the testimony, where I meet with you.
17.5: `And it has come to pass, the man's rod on whom I fix does flourish, and I have caused to cease from off me the murmurings of the sons of Israel, which they are murmuring against you.'
17.6: And Moses speaks to the sons of Israel, and all their princes give to him one rod for a prince, one rod for a prince, for their fathers' house, twelve rods, and the rod of Aaron is in the midst of their rods;
17.7: and Moses places the rods before Jehovah, in the tent of the testimony.
17.8: And it comes to pass, on the morrow, that Moses goes in to the tent of the testimony, and indeed, the rod of Aaron has flourished for the house of Levi, and is bringing out flourishing, and does blossom blossoms, and does produce almonds;
17.9: and Moses brings out all the rods from before Jehovah, to all the sons of Israel, and they look, and take each his rod.
17.10: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Put back the rod of Aaron, before the testimony, for a charge, for a sign to the sons of rebellion, and you do remove their murmurings from off me, and they do not die;'
17.11: and Moses does as Jehovah has commanded him; so he has done.
17.12: And the sons of Israel speak to Moses, saying, `Indeed, we have expired; we have perished; we have all of us perished;
17.13: any who is at all drawing near to the tabernacle of Jehovah dies; have we not been consumed--to expire?'

18.1: And Jehovah says to Aaron, `You, and your sons, and the house of your father with you, do bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you, and your sons with you, do bear the iniquity of your priesthood;
18.2: and also your brethren, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, bring near with you, and they are joined to you, and serve you, even you and your sons with you, before the tent of the testimony.
18.3: `And they have kept your charge, and the charge of all the tent; only, to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar they do not come near, and they die not, either they or you;
18.4: and they have been joined to you, and have kept the charge of the tent of meeting, for all the service of the tent; and a stranger does not come near to you;
18.5: and you have kept the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar, and there is no more wrath against the sons of Israel.
18.6: `And I, indeed, I have taken your brethren the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel; to you a gift they are given by Jehovah, to do the service of the tent of meeting;
18.7: and you, and your sons with you, do keep your priesthood, for everything of the altar, and within the vail, and you have served; a service of gift I make your priesthood; and the stranger who is coming near is put to death.'
18.8: And Jehovah speaks to Aaron: `And I, indeed, I have given to you the charge of My heave-offerings, of all the hallowed things of the sons of Israel--to you I have given them for the anointing, and to your sons, by a statute age-during.
18.9: This is yours of the most holy things, from the fire: all their offering, to all their present, and to all their sin-offering, and to all their guilt-offering, which they give back to Me, is most holy to you, and to your sons;
18.10: in the holy of holies you do eat it; every male does eat it; holy it is to you.
18.11: `And this is yours: the heave-offering of their gift, to all the wave-offerings of the sons of Israel, to you I have given them, and to your sons, and to your daughters with you, by a statute age-during; every clean one in your house does eat it;
18.12: all the best of the oil, and all the best of the new wine, and wheat--their first- fruits which they give to Jehovah--to you I have given them.
18.13: `The first-fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring in to Jehovah, are yours; every clean one in your house does eat it;
18.14: every devoted thing in Israel is yours,
18.15: every one opening a womb of all flesh which they bring near to Jehovah, among man and among beast, is yours; only, you do certainly ransom the first-born of man, and the firstling of the unclean beast you do ransom.
18.16: `And their ransomed ones from a son of a month, you do ransom with your valuation, of silver, five shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, twenty gerahs it is.
18.17: `Only, the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, you do not ransom, holy they are: their blood you do sprinkle on the altar, and of their fat you make perfume, a fire-offering of sweet fragrance to Jehovah,
18.18: and their flesh is yours, as the breast of the wave-offering, and as the right leg, it is yours;
18.19: all the heave-offerings of the holy things which the sons of Israel lift up to Jehovah I have given to you and to your sons, and to your daughters with you, by a statute age-during, a covenant of salt, age-during it is before Jehovah, to you and to your seed with you.'
18.20: And Jehovah says to Aaron, `In their land you do not inherit, and a portion you have not in their midst: I am your portion, and your inheritance in the midst of the sons of Israel;
18.21: and to the sons of Levi, indeed, I have given all the tenth in Israel for inheritance in exchange for their service which they are serving--the service of the tent of meeting.
18.22: `And the sons of Israel come no more near to the tent of meeting, to bear sin, to die,
18.23: and the Levites have done the service of the tent of meeting, and they--they bear their iniquity; a statute age-during to your generations, that in the midst of the sons of Israel they have no inheritance;
18.24: but the tithe of the sons of Israel which they lift up to Jehovah, a heave-offering, I have given to the Levites for inheritance; therefore I have said of them, In the midst of the sons of Israel they have no inheritance.'
18.25: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
18.26: `And to the Levites you do speak; and you have said to them, When you take from the sons of Israel the tithe which I have given to you from them, for your inheritance, then you have lifted up from it the heave-offering of Jehovah, a tithe of the tithe;
18.27: and your heave-offering has been reckoned to you as corn from the threshing-floor, and as fulness from the wine-vat;
18.28: so you do lift up--you also--the heave-offering of Jehovah from all your tithes which you receive from the sons of Israel; and you have given from it the heave-offering of Jehovah to Aaron the priest;
18.29: out of all your gifts you do lift up the whole heave-offering of Jehovah; out of all its fat, --its hallowed part--out of it.
18.30: `And you have said to them, In your lifting up its fat out of it, then it has been reckoned to the Levites, as increase of a threshing-floor, and as increase of a wine-vat;
18.31: and you have eaten it in every place, you and your households, for it is your hire in exchange for your service in the tent of meeting;
18.32: and you bear no sin for it, in your lifting up its fat out of it, and the holy things of the sons of Israel you do not pollute, and you die not.'

19.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, and to Aaron, saying,
19.2: `This is a statute of the law which Jehovah has commanded, saying, Speak to the sons of Israel, and they bring to you a red cow, a perfect one, in which there is no blemish, on which no yoke has gone up;
19.3: and you have given it to Eleazar the priest, and he has brought it out to the outside of the camp, and has slaughtered it before him.
19.4: `And Eleazar the priest has taken of its blood with his finger, and has sprinkled over-against the front of the tent of meeting of her blood seven times;
19.5: and one has burnt the cow before his eyes; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, besides her dung, he does burn;
19.6: and the priest has taken cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and has cast to the midst of the burning of the cow;
19.7: and the priest has washed his garments, and has bathed his flesh with water, and afterwards does come in to the camp, and the priest is unclean till the evening;
19.8: and he who is burning it does wash his garments with water, and has bathed his flesh with water, and is unclean till the evening.
19.9: `And a clean man has gathered the ashes of the cow, and has placed at the outside of the camp, in a clean place, and it has become to the company of the sons of Israel a charge for waters of separation--it is a cleansing;
19.10: and he who is gathering the ashes of the heifer has washed his garments, and is unclean till the evening; and it has been to the sons of Israel, and to the sojourner who is sojourning in their midst, for a statute age-during.
19.11: `He who is coming against the dead body of any man--is unclean seven days;
19.12: he does cleanse himself for it on the third day, and on the seventh day he is clean; and if he cleanse not himself on the third day, then on the seventh day he is not clean.
19.13: Any one who is coming against the dead, against the body of man who dies, and cleanses not himself--the tabernacle of Jehovah he has defiled, and that person has been cut off from Israel, for water of separation is not sprinkled upon him; he is unclean; his uncleanness is still upon him.
19.14: `This is the law, when a man dies in a tent: every one who is coming in to the tent, and all that is in the tent, is unclean seven days;
19.15: and every open vessel which has no covering of thread upon it is unclean.
19.16: `And every one who comes, on the face of the field, against the pierced of a sword, or against the dead, or against a bone of man, or against a grave, is unclean seven days;
19.17: and they have taken for the unclean person of the ashes of the burning of the cleansing, and he has put upon it running water to a vessel;
19.18: and a clean person has taken hyssop, and has dipped it in water, and has sprinkled on the tent, and on all the vessels, and on the persons who have been there, and on him who is coming against a bone, or against one pierced, or against the dead, or against a grave.
19.19: `And the clean has sprinkled it on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day, and has cleansed him on the seventh day, and he has washed his garments, and has bathed with water, and has been clean in the evening.
19.20: `And the man who is unclean, and does not cleanse himself, even that person has been cut off from the midst of the assembly; for the sanctuary of Jehovah he has defiled; water of separation is not sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
19.21: `And it has been to them for a statute age-during, that he who is sprinkling the water of separation does wash his garments, and he who is coming against the water of separation is unclean till the evening,
19.22: and all against which the unclean person comes is unclean, and the person who is coming against it is unclean till the evening.'

20.1: And the sons of Israel come in, --all the company--to the wilderness of Zin, in the first month, and the people abide in Kadesh, and Miriam dies there, and is buried there.
20.2: And there has been no water for the company, and they are assembled against Moses, and against Aaron,
20.3: and the people strive with Moses, and speak, saying, `And oh that we had expired when our brethren expired before Jehovah!
20.4: and why have you brought in the assembly of Jehovah to this wilderness to die there, we and our beasts?
20.5: and why have you brought us up out of Egypt to bring us in to this evil place? no place of seed, and fig, and vine, and pomegranate; and water there is none to drink.
20.6: And Moses and Aaron go in from the presence of the assembly to the opening of the tent of meeting, and fall on their faces, and the honour of Jehovah is seen by them.
20.7: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
20.8: `Take the rod, and assemble the company, you and Aaron your brother; and you have spoken to the rock before their eyes, and it has given its water, and you have brought out to them water from the rock, and have watered the company, and their beasts.'
20.9: And Moses takes the rod from before Jehovah, as He has commanded him,
20.10: and Moses and Aaron assemble the assembly to the front of the rock, and he says to them, `Hear, I pray you, O rebels, from this rock do we bring out to you water?'
20.11: and Moses lifts up his hand, and smites the rock with his rod twice; and much water comes out, and the company drink, also their beasts.
20.12: And Jehovah says to Moses, and to Aaron, `Because you have not believed in Me to sanctify Me before the eyes of the sons of Israel, therefore you do not bring in this assembly to the land which I have given to them.'
20.13: These are waters of Meribah, because the sons of Israel have `striven' with Jehovah, and He is sanctified upon them.
20.14: And Moses sends messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, `Thus said your brother Israel, You--you have known all the travail which has found us;
20.15: that our fathers go down to Egypt, and we dwell in Egypt many days, and the Egyptians do evil to us and to our fathers;
20.16: and we cry to Jehovah, and He hears our voice, and sends a messenger, and is bringing us out of Egypt; and indeed, we are in Kadesh, a city in the extremity of your border.
20.17: Let us pass over, we pray you, through your land; we pass not over through a field, or through a vineyard, nor do we drink waters of a well; the way of the king we go, we turn not aside--right or left--till that we pass over your border.'
20.18: And Edom says to him, `You do not pass over through me, lest with sword I come out to meet you.'
20.19: And the sons of Israel say to him, `In the highway we go, and if of your waters we drink--I and my cattle--then I have given their price; only (it is nothing) on my feet I pass over.'
20.20: And he says, `You do not pass over;' and Edom comes out to meet him with much people, and with a strong hand;
20.21: and Edom refuses to suffer Israel to pass over through his border, and Israel turns aside from off him.
20.22: And the sons of Israel, the whole company, journey from Kadesh, and come in to mount Hor,
20.23: and Jehovah speaks to Moses and to Aaron in mount Hor, on the border of the land of Edom, saying,
20.24: `Aaron is gathered to his people, for he does not go in to the land which I have given to the sons of Israel, because that you provoked My mouth at the waters of Meribah.
20.25: `Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and cause them to go up mount Hor,
20.26: and strip Aaron of his garments, and you have clothed with them Eleazar his son, and Aaron is gathered, and does die there.'
20.27: And Moses does as Jehovah has commanded, and they go up to mount Hor before the eyes of all the company,
20.28: and Moses strips Aaron of his garments, and clothes with them Eleazar his son, and Aaron dies there on the top of the mount; and Moses comes down--Eleazar also--from the mount,
20.29: and all the company see that Aaron has expired, and they bewail Aaron thirty days--all the house of Israel.

21.1: And the Canaanite--king Arad--dwelling in the south, hears that Israel has come the way of the Atharim, and he fights against Israel, and takes some of them captive.
21.2: And Israel vows a vow to Jehovah, and says, `If You do certainly give this people into my hand, then I have devoted their cities;'
21.3: and Jehovah hearkens to the voice of Israel, and gives up the Canaanite, and he devotes them and their cities, and calls the name of the place Hormah.
21.4: And they journey from mount Hor, the way of the Red Sea, to compass the land of Edom, and the soul of the people is short in the way,
21.5: and the people speak against God, and against Moses, `Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in a wilderness? for there is no bread, and there is no water, and our soul has been weary of this light bread.'
21.6: And Jehovah sends among the people the burning serpents, and they bite the people, and much people of Israel die;
21.7: and the people come in to Moses and say, `We have sinned, for we have spoken against Jehovah, and against you; pray to Jehovah, and He does turn aside from us the serpent;' and Moses prays in behalf of the people.
21.8: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Make for you a burning serpent, and set it on an ensign; and it has been, every one who is bitten and has seen it--he has lived.
21.9: And Moses makes a serpent of brass, and sets it on the ensign, and it has been, if the serpent has bitten any man, and he has looked expectingly to the serpent of brass--he has lived.
21.10: And the sons of Israel journey, and encamp in Oboth.
21.11: And they journey from Oboth, and encamp in Ije-Abarim, in the wilderness that is on the front of Moab, at the rising of the sun.
21.12: From from there they have journeyed, and encamp in the valley of Zared.
21.13: From from there they have journeyed, and encamp beyond Arnon, which is in the wilderness which is coming out of the border of the Amorite, for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorite;
21.14: therefore it is said in a book, `The wars of Jehovah,' --`Waheb in Suphah, And the brooks of Arnon;
21.15: And the spring of the brooks, Which turned aside to the dwelling of Ar, And has leaned to the border of Moab.'
21.16: And from from there they journeyed to Beer; it is the well concerning which Jehovah said to Moses, `Gather the people, and I give to them--water.'
21.17: Then sings Israel this song, concerning the well--they have answered to it:
21.18: `A well--digged it have princes, Prepared it have nobles of the people, With the lawgiver, with their staves.' And from the wilderness they journeyed to Mattanah,
21.19: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth,
21.20: and from Bamoth in the valley which is in the field of Moab to the top of Pisgah, which has looked on the front of the wilderness.
21.21: And Israel sends messengers to Sihon king of the Amorite, saying,
21.22: `Let me pass through your land, we do not turn aside into a field, or into a vineyard, we do not drink waters of a well; in the king's way we go, till that we pass over your border.'
21.23: And Sihon has not suffered Israel to pass through his border, and Sihon gathers all his people, and comes out to meet Israel into the wilderness, and comes in to Jahaz, and fights against Israel.
21.24: And Israel smites him by the mouth of the sword, and possesses his land from Arnon to Jabbok--to the sons of Ammon; for the border of the sons of Ammon is strong.
21.25: And Israel takes all these cities, and Israel dwells in all the cities of the Amorite, in Heshbon, and in all its villages;
21.26: for Heshbon is a city of Sihon king of the Amorite, and he has fought against the former king of Moab, and takes all his land out of his hand, to Arnon;
21.27: therefore those using similes say--`Enter you Heshbon, Let the city of Sihon be built and ready,
21.28: For fire has gone out from Heshbon, A flame from the city of Sihon, It has consumed Ar of Moab, Owners of the high places of Arnon.
21.29: Woe to you, O Moab, You have perished, O people of Chemosh, He has given his sons who escape--Also his daughters--Into captivity, to a king of the Amorite--Sihon!
21.30: And we shoot them, Perished has Heshbon to Dibon, And we make desolate to Nophah, Which is to Medeba.'
21.31: And Israel dwells in the land of the Amorite,
21.32: and Moses sends to spy out Jaazer, and they capture its villages, and dispossess the Amorite who is there,
21.33: and turn and go up the way of Bashan, and Og king of Bashan comes out to meet them, he and all his people, to battle, at Edrei.
21.34: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Fear him not, for into your hand I have given him, and all his people, and his land, and you have done to him as you have done to Sihon king of the Amorite, who is dwelling in Heshbon.'
21.35: And they smite him, and his sons, and all his people, until he has not left to him a remnant, and they possess his land.

22.1: And the sons of Israel journey and encamp in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan, by Jericho.
22.2: And Balak son of Zippor sees all that Israel has done to the Amorite,
22.3: and Moab is exceedingly afraid of the presence of the people, for it is numerous; and Moab is vexed by the presence of the sons of Israel,
22.4: and Moab says to the elders of Midian, `Now does the assembly lick up all that is round about us, as the ox licks up the green thing of the field.' And Balak son of Zippor is king of Moab at that time,
22.5: and he sends messengers to Balaam son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River of the land of the sons of his people, to call for him, saying, `Indeed, a people has come out of Egypt; indeed, it has covered the eye of the land, and it is abiding over-against me;
22.6: and now, come, I pray you, curse for me this people, for it is mightier than I; it may be I prevail--we smite it--and I cast it out from the land; for I have known--that which you bless is blessed, and that which you curse is cursed.'
22.7: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian go, and divinations in their hand, and they come in to Balaam, and speak to him the words of Balak,
22.8: and he says to them, `Lodge here to-night, and I have brought you back word, as Jehovah speaks to me;' and the princes of Moab abide with Balaam.
22.9: And God comes in to Balaam, and says, `Who are these men with you?'
22.10: And Balaam says to God, `Balak, son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent to me:
22.11: Indeed, the people that is coming out from Egypt and covers the eye of the land, --now come, pierce it for me; it may be I am able to fight against it, and have cast it out;'
22.12: and God says to Balaam, `You do not go with them; you do not curse the people; for it is blessed.'
22.13: And Balaam rises in the morning, and says to the princes of Balak, `Go to your land, for Jehovah is refusing to suffer me to go with you;'
22.14: and the princes of Moab rise, and come in to Balak, and say, `Balaam is refusing to come with us.'
22.15: And Balak adds yet to send princes, more numerous and honoured than these,
22.16: and they come in to Balaam, and say to him, `Thus said Balak son of Zippor, Be not, I pray you, withheld from coming to me,
22.17: for very greatly I honour you, and all that you say to me I do; and come, I pray you, pierce for me this people.'
22.18: And Balaam answers and says to the servants of Balak, `If Balak does give to me the fulness of his house of silver and gold, I am not able to pass over the command of Jehovah my God, to do a little or a great thing;
22.19: and, now, abide, I pray you, in this place, you also, to-night; and I know what Jehovah is adding to speak with me.'
22.20: And God comes in to Balaam, by night, and says to him, `If to call for you the men have come, rise, go with them, and only the thing which I speak to you--it you do do.'
22.21: And Balaam rises in the morning, and saddles his ass, and goes with the princes of Moab,
22.22: and the anger of God burns because he is going, and a messenger of Jehovah stations himself in the way for an adversary to him, and he is riding on his ass, and two of his servants are with him,
22.23: and the ass sees the messenger of Jehovah standing in the way, and his drawn sword in his hand, and the ass turns aside out of the way, and goes into a field, and Balaam smites the ass to turn it aside into the way.
22.24: And the messenger of Jehovah stands in a narrow path of the vineyards--a wall on this side and a wall on that--
22.25: and the ass sees the messenger of Jehovah, and is pressed to the wall, and presses Balaam's foot to the wall, and he adds to smite her;
22.26: and the messenger of Jehovah adds to pass over, and stands in a strait place where there is no way to turn aside--right or left--
22.27: and the ass sees the messenger of Jehovah, and crouches under Balaam, and the anger of Balaam burns, and he smites the ass with a staff.
22.28: And Jehovah opens the mouth of the ass, and she says to Balaam, `What have I done to you that you have smitten me these three times?'
22.29: and Balaam says to the ass, `Because you have rolled yourself against me; oh that there were a sword in my hand, for now I had slain you;'
22.30: and the ass says to Balaam, `Am not I your ass, upon which you have ridden since I was yours to this day? have I at all been accustomed to do to you thus?' and he says, `No.'
22.31: And Jehovah uncovers the eyes of Balaam, and he sees the messenger of Jehovah standing in the way, and his drawn sword in his hand, and he bows and does obeisance, to his face;
22.32: and the messenger of Jehovah says to him, `Wherefore have you smitten your ass these three times? indeed, I--I have come out for an adversary, for your way has been perverse before me,
22.33: and the ass sees me, and turns aside at my presence these three times; unless she had turned aside from my presence, surely now also, you I had slain, and her kept alive.'
22.34: And Balaam says to the messenger of Jehovah, `I have sinned, for I did not know that you are standing to meet me in the way; and now, if evil in your eyes--I turn back by myself.'
22.35: And the messenger of Jehovah says to Balaam, `Go with the men; and only the word which I speak to you--it you do speak;' and Balaam goes with the princes of Balak.
22.36: And Balak hears that Balaam has come, and goes out to meet him, to a city of Moab, which is on the border of Arnon, which is in the extremity of the border;
22.37: and Balak says to Balaam, `Did I not diligently sent to you to call for you? why did you not come to me? am I not truly able to honour you?'
22.38: And Balaam says to Balak, `Indeed, I have come to you; now--am I at all able to speak anything? the word which God sets in my mouth--it I do speak.'
22.39: And Balaam goes with Balak, and they come to Kirjath-Huzoth,
22.40: and Balak sacrifices oxen and sheep, and sends to Balaam, and to the princes who are with him;
22.41: and it comes to pass in the morning, that Balak takes Balaam, and causes him to go up the high places of Baal, and he sees from from there the extremity of the people.

23.1: And Balaam says to Balak, `Build for me in this place seven altars, and make ready for me in this place seven bullocks and seven rams.'
23.2: And Balak does as Balaam has spoken, and Balak--Balaam also--offers a bullock and a ram on the altar,
23.3: and Balaam says to Balak, `Station yourself by your burnt-offering and I go on, it may be Jehovah does come to meet me, and the thing which He shows me--I have declared to you;' and he goes to a high place.
23.4: And God comes to Balaam, and he says to Him, `The seven altars I have arranged, and I offer a bullock and a ram on the altar;'
23.5: and Jehovah puts a word in the mouth of Balaam, and says, `Turn back to Balak, and thus you do speak.'
23.6: And he turns back to him, and indeed, he is standing by his burnt-offering, he and all the princes of Moab.
23.7: And he takes up his simile, and says: `From Aram he does lead me--Balak king of Moab; From mountains of the east: Come--curse for me Jacob, And come--be indignant with Israel.
23.8: What--do I pierce? --God has not pierced! And what--am I indignant? --Jehovah has not been indignant!
23.9: For from the top of rocks I see it, And from heights I behold it; Indeed a people! alone it does tabernacle, And among nations does not reckon itself.
23.10: Who has counted the dust of Jacob, And the number of the fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of upright ones, And let my last end be like his!'
23.11: And Balak says to Balaam, `What have you done to me? to pierce my enemies I have taken you--and indeed, you have certainly blessed;'
23.12: and he answers and says, `That which Jehovah does put in my mouth--it do I not take heed to speak?'
23.13: And Balak says to him, `Come, I pray you, with me to another place, from where you do see it, only its extremity you do see, and all of it you do not see, and pierce it for me from there;'
23.14: and he takes him to the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and builds seven altars, and offers a bullock and a ram on the altar.
23.15: And he says to Balak, `Station yourself here by your burnt-offering, and I--I meet Him there;'
23.16: and Jehovah comes to Balaam, and sets a word in his mouth, and says, `Turn back to Balak, and thus you do speak.'
23.17: And he comes to him, and indeed, he is standing by his burnt-offering, and the princes of Moab with him, and Balak says to him: `What has Jehovah spoken?'
23.18: And he takes up his simile, and says: `Rise, Balak, and hear; Give ear to me, son of Zippor!
23.19: God is not a man--and lies, And a son of man--and repents! Has He said--and does He not do it? And spoken--and does He not confirm it?
23.20: Indeed, to bless I have received: Yes, He blesses, and I can not reverse it.
23.21: He has not beheld iniquity in Jacob, Nor has He seen perverseness in Israel; Jehovah his God is with him, And a shout of a king is in him.
23.22: God is bringing them out from Egypt, As the swiftness of a Reem is to him;
23.23: For no enchantment is against Jacob, Nor divination against Israel, At the time it is said of Jacob and Israel, What has God worked!
23.24: Indeed, the people as a lioness rises, And as a lion he lifts himself up, He lies not down till he eats prey, And blood of pierced ones does drink.'
23.25: And Balak says to Balaam, `Neither pierce it at all, nor bless it at all;'
23.26: and Balaam answers and says to Balak, `Have I not spoken to you, saying, All that Jehovah speaks--it I do?'
23.27: And Balak says to Balaam, `Come, I pray you, I take you to another place; it may be it is right in the eyes of God--to pierce it for me from from there.'
23.28: And Balak takes Balaam to the top of Peor, which is looking on the front of the wilderness,
23.29: and Balaam says to Balak, `Build for me in this place seven altars, and make ready for me in this place seven bullocks and seven rams;'
23.30: and Balak does as Balaam said, and he offers a bullock and a ram on an altar.

24.1: And Balaam sees that it is good in the eyes of Jehovah to bless Israel, and he has not gone as time by time to meet enchantments, and he sets toward the wilderness his face;
24.2: and Balaam lifts up his eyes, and sees Israel tabernacling, by its tribes, and the Spirit of God is upon him,
24.3: and he takes up his simile, and says: `An affirmation of Balaam son of Beor--And an affirmation of the man whose eyes are shut--
24.4: An affirmation of him who is hearing sayings of God--Who a vision of the Almighty sees, Falling--and eyes uncovered:
24.5: How good have been your tents, O Jacob, Your tabernacles, O Israel;
24.6: As valleys they have been stretched out, As gardens by a river; As aloes Jehovah has planted, As cedars by waters;
24.7: He makes water flow from his buckets, And his seed is in many waters; And higher than Agag is his king, And exalted is his kingdom.
24.8: God is bringing him out of Egypt; As the swiftness of a Reem is to him, He eats up nations his adversaries, And their bones he breaks, And with his arrows he smites,
24.9: He has bent, he has lain down as a lion, And as a lioness: who does raise him up? He who is blessing you is blessed, And he who is cursing you is cursed.'
24.10: And the anger of Balak burns against Balaam, and he strikes his hands; and Balak says to Balaam, `To pierce my enemies I called you, and indeed, you have certainly blessed--these three times;
24.11: and now, flee for yourself to your place; I have said, I do greatly honour you, and indeed, Jehovah has kept you back from honour.'
24.12: And Balaam says to Balak, `Did I not also to your messengers whom you have sent to me, speak, saying,
24.13: If Balak does give to me the fulness of his house of silver and gold, I am not able to pass over the command of Jehovah, to do good or evil of my own heart--that which Jehovah speaks--it I speak?
24.14: and, now, indeed, I am going to my people; come, I counsel you concerning that which this people does to your people, in the latter end of the days.'
24.15: And he takes up his simile, and says: `An affirmation of Balaam son of Beor--And an affirmation of the man whose eyes are shut--
24.16: An affirmation of him who is hearing sayings of God--And knowing knowledge of the Most High; A vision of the Almighty he sees, Falling--and eyes uncovered:
24.17: I see it, but not now; I behold it, but not near; A star has proceeded from Jacob, And a sceptre has risen from Israel, And has smitten corners of Moab, And has destroyed all sons of Shes.
24.18: And Edom has been a possession, And Seir has been a possession, for its enemies, And Israel is doing valiantly;
24.19: And one does rule out of Jacob, And has destroyed a remnant from Ar.'
24.20: And he sees Amalek, and takes up his simile, and says: `A beginning of the Goyim is Amalek; And his latter end--for ever he perishes.'
24.21: And he sees the Kenite, and takes up his simile, and says: `Enduring is your dwelling, And setting in a rock your nest,
24.22: But the Kenite is for a burning; Till when does Asshur keep you captive?'
24.23: And he takes up his simile, and says: `Alas! who does live when God does this?
24.24: And--ships are from the side of Chittim, And they have humbled Asshur, And they have humbled Eber, And it also for ever is perishing.'
24.25: And Balaam rises, and goes, and turns back to his place, and Balak also has gone on his way.

25.1: And Israel dwells in Shittim, and the people begin to go a-whoring to daughters of Moab,
25.2: and they call for the people to the sacrifices of their gods, and the people eat, and bow themselves to their gods,
25.3: and Israel is joined to Baal-Peor, and the anger of Jehovah burns against Israel.
25.4: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them before Jehovah--over-against the sun; and the fierceness of the anger of Jehovah does turn back from Israel.'
25.5: And Moses says to the judges of Israel, `Slay you each his men who are joined to Baal-Peor.'
25.6: And indeed, a man of the sons of Israel has come, and brings in to his brethren the Midianitess, before the eyes of Moses, and before the eyes of all the company of the sons of Israel, who are weeping at the opening of the tent of meeting;
25.7: and Phinehas, son of Eleazar, son of Aaron, the priest, sees, and rises from the midst of the company, and takes a javelin in his hand,
25.8: and goes in after the man of Israel to the hollow place, and pierces them both, the man of Israel and the woman--to her belly, and the plague is restrained from the sons of Israel;
25.9: and the dead by the plague are four and twenty thousand.
25.10: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
25.11: `Phinehas, son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, has turned back My fury from the sons of Israel, by his being zealous with My zeal in their midst, and I have not consumed the sons of Israel in My zeal.
25.12: `Therefore say, Indeed, I am giving to him My covenant of peace,
25.13: and it has been to him and to his seed after him a covenant of a priesthood age-during, because that he has been zealous for his God, and does make atonement for the sons of Israel.'
25.14: And the name of the man of Israel who is smitten, who has been smitten with the Midianitess, is Zimri son of Salu, prince of the house of a father of the Simeonite;
25.15: and the name of the woman who is smitten, the Midianitess, is Cozbi daughter of Zur, head of a people--of the house of a father in Midian is he.
25.16: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
25.17: `Distress the Midianites, and you have smitten them,
25.18: for they are adversaries to you with their frauds, with which they have acted fraudulently to you, concerning the matter of Peor, and concerning the matter of Cozbi, daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, who is smitten in the day of the plague for the matter of Peor.'

26.1: And it comes to pass, after the plague, that Jehovah speaks to Moses, and to Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, saying,
26.2: `Take up the sum of all the company of the sons of Israel, from a son of twenty years and upward, by the house of their fathers, every one going out to the host in Israel.'
26.3: And Moses speaks--Eleazar the priest also--with them, in the plains of Moab, by Jordan, near Jericho, saying,
26.4: `From a son of twenty years and upward,' as Jehovah has commanded Moses and the sons of Israel who are coming out from the land of Egypt.
26.5: Reuben, first-born of Israel--sons of Reuben: of Hanoch is the family of the Hanochite; of Pallu the family of the Palluite;
26.6: of Hezron the family of the Hezronite; of Carmi the family of the Carmite.
26.7: These are families of the Reubenite, and their numbered ones are three and forty thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
26.8: And the son of Pallu is Eliab;
26.9: and the sons of Eliab are Nemuel and Dathan and Abiram; this is that Dathan and Abiram, called ones of the company, who have striven against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, in their striving against Jehovah,
26.10: and the earth opens her mouth, and swallows them and Korah, in the death of the company, in the fire consuming the two hundred and fifty men, and they become a sign;
26.11: and the sons of Korah died not.
26.12: Sons of Simeon by their families: of Nemuel is the family of the Nemuelite; of Jamin the family of the Jaminite; of Jachin the family of the Jachinite;
26.13: of Zerah the family of the Zarhite; of Shaul the family of the Shaulite.
26.14: These are families of the Simeonite, two and twenty thousand and two hundred.
26.15: Sons of Gad by their families: of Zephon is the family of the Zephonite; of Haggi the family of the Haggite; of Shuni the family of the Shunite;
26.16: of Ozni the family of the Oznite; of Eri the family of the Erite:
26.17: of Arod the family of the Arodite; of Areli the family of the Arelite.
26.18: These are families of the sons of Gad, by their numbered ones, forty thousand and five hundred.
26.19: Sons of Judah are Er and Onan; and Er dies--Onan also--in the land of Canaan.
26.20: And sons of Judah, by their families, are: of Shelah the family of the Shelanite; of Pharez the family of the Pharzite; of Zerah the family of the Zarhite;
26.21: and sons of Pharez are: of Hezron the family of the Hezronite; of Hamul the family of the Hamulite.
26.22: These are families of Judah, by their numbered ones, six and seventy thousand and five hundred.
26.23: Sons of Issachar by their families; of Tola is the family of the Tolaite; of Pua the family of the Punite;
26.24: of Jashub the family of the Jashubite; of Shimron the family of the Shimronite.
26.25: These are families of Issachar, by their numbered ones, four and sixty thousand and three hundred.
26.26: Sons of Zebulun by their families: of Sered is the family of the Sardite; of Elon the family of the Elonite; of Jahleel the family of the Jahleelite.
26.27: These are families of the Zebulunite by their numbered ones, sixty thousand and five hundred.
26.28: Sons of Joseph by their families are Manasseh and Ephraim.
26.29: Sons of Manasseh: of Machir is the family of the Machirite; and Machir has begotten Gilead; of Gilead is the family of the Gileadite.
26.30: These are sons of Gilead: of Jeezer is the family of the Jeezerite; of Helek the family of the Helekite;
26.31: and of Asriel the family of the Asrielite; and of Shechem the family of the Shechemite;
26.32: and of Shemida the family of the Shemidaite; and of Hepher the family of the Hepherite.
26.33: And Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons but daughters, and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad are Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
26.34: These are families of Manasseh, and their numbered ones are two and fifty thousand and seven hundred.
26.35: These are sons of Ephraim by their families: of Shuthelah is the family of the Shuthelhite; of Becher the family of the Bachrite; of Tahan the family of the Tahanite.
26.36: And these are sons of Shuthelah: of Eran the family of the Eranite.
26.37: These are families of the sons of Ephraim, by their numbered ones, two and thirty thousand and five hundred. These are sons of Joseph by their families.
26.38: Sons of Benjamin by their families: of Bela is the family of the Belaite; of Ashbel the family of the Ashbelite; of Ahiram the family of the Ahiramite;
26.39: of Shupham the family of the Shuphamite; of Hupham the family of the Huphamite.
26.40: And sons of Bela are Ard and Naaman: of Ard is the family of the Ardite: of Naaman the family of the Naamite.
26.41: These are sons of Benjamin by their families, and their numbered ones are five and forty thousand and six hundred.
26.42: These are sons of Dan by their families: of Shuham is the family of the Shuhamite; these are families of Dan by their families;
26.43: all the families of the Shuhamite, by their numbered ones, are four and sixty thousand and four hundred.
26.44: Sons of Asher by their families: of Jimna is the family of the Jimnite; of Jesui the family of the Jesuite; of Beriah the family of the Beriite.
26.45: Of sons of Beriah: of Heber is the family of the Heberite; of Malchiel the family of the Malchielite.
26.46: And the name of the daughter of Asher is Sarah.
26.47: These are families of the sons of Asher, by their numbered ones, three and fifty thousand and four hundred.
26.48: Sons of Naphtali by their families: of Jahzeel is the family of the Jahzeelite; of Guni the family of the Gunite;
26.49: of Jezer the family of the Jezerite; of Shillem the family of the Shillemite.
26.50: These are families of Naphtali by their families, and their numbered ones are five and forty thousand and four hundred.
26.51: These are numbered ones of the sons of Israel, six hundred thousand, and a thousand, seven hundred and thirty.
26.52: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
26.53: `To these is the land apportioned by inheritance, by the number of names;
26.54: to the many you do increase their inheritance, and to the few you do diminish their inheritance; to each according to his numbered ones is given his inheritance.
26.55: `Only by lot is the land apportioned, by the names of the tribes of their fathers they inherit;
26.56: according to the lot is their inheritance apportioned between many and few.'
26.57: And these are numbered ones of the Levite by their families: of Gershon is the family of the Gershonite; of Kohath the family of the Kohathite; of Merari the family of the Merarite.
26.58: These are families of the Levite: the family of the Libnite, the family of the Hebronite, the family of the Mahlite, the family of the Mushite, the family of the Korathite. And Kohath has begotten Amram,
26.59: and the name of Amram's wife is Jochebed, daughter of Levi, whom one has born to Levi in Egypt; and she bears to Amram Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
26.60: And born to Aaron Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar;
26.61: and Nadab dies--Abihu also--in their bringing near strange fire before Jehovah.
26.62: And their numbered ones are three and twenty thousand, every male from a son of a month and upwards, for they have not numbered themselves in the midst of the sons of Israel; for an inheritance has not been given to them in the midst of the sons of Israel.
26.63: These are those numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who have numbered the sons of Israel in the plains of Moab, by Jordan, near Jericho;
26.64: and among these there has not been a man of those numbered by Moses, and Aaron the priest, who numbered the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai,
26.65: for Jehovah said of them, `They do certainly die in the wilderness;' and there has not been left of them a man save Caleb son of Jephunneh, and Joshua son of Nun.

27.1: And daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh son of Joseph, draw near--and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah--
27.2: and stand before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes, and all the company, at the opening of the tent of meeting, saying:
27.3: `Our father died in the wilderness, and he--he was not in the midst of the company who were met together against Jehovah in the company of Korah, but for his own sin he died, and had no sons;
27.4: why is the name of our father withdrawn from the midst of his family because he has no son? give to us a possession in the midst of the brethren of our father;'
27.5: and Moses brings near their cause before Jehovah.
27.6: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
27.7: `Rightly are the daughters of Zelophehad speaking; you do certainly give to them a possession of an inheritance in the midst of their father's brethren, and have caused to pass over the inheritance of their father to them.
27.8: `And to the sons of Israel you do speak, saying, When a man dies, and has no son, then you have caused his inheritance to pass over to his daughter;
27.9: and if he have no daughter, then you have given his inheritance to his brethren;
27.10: and if he have no brethren, then you have given his inheritance to his father's brethren;
27.11: and if his father have no brethren, then you have given his inheritance to his relation who is near to him of his family, and he has possessed it;' and it has been to the sons of Israel for a statute of judgment, as Jehovah has commanded Moses.
27.12: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Go up to this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the sons of Israel;
27.13: and you have seen it, and you have been gathered to your people, also you, as Aaron your brother has been gathered,
27.14: because you provoked My mouth in the wilderness of Zin, in the strife of the company--to sanctify Me at the waters before their eyes;' they are waters of Meribah, in Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin.
27.15: And Moses speaks to Jehovah, saying,
27.16: `Jehovah--God of the spirits of all flesh--appoint a man over the company,
27.17: who goes out before them, and who comes in before them, and who takes them out, and who brings them in, and the company of Jehovah is not as sheep which have no shepherd.'
27.18: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Take to you Joshua son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and you have laid your hand upon him,
27.19: and have caused him to stand before Eleazar the priest, and before all the company, and have charged him before their eyes,
27.20: and have put of your honour upon him, so that all the company of the sons of Israel do hearken.
27.21: `And before Eleazar the priest he stands, and he has asked for him by the judgment of the Lights before Jehovah; at His word they go out, and at His word they come in; he, and all the sons of Israel with him, even all the company.'
27.22: And Moses does as Jehovah has commanded him, and takes Joshua, and causes him to stand before Eleazar the priest, and before all the company,
27.23: and lays his hands upon him, and charges him, as Jehovah has spoken by the hand of Moses.

28.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
28.2: `Command the sons of Israel, and you have said to them, My offering, My bread for My fire-offerings, My sweet fragrance, you take heed to bring near to Me in its appointed season.
28.3: `And you have said to them, This is the fire-offering which you bring near to Jehovah: two lambs, sons of a year, perfect ones, daily, a continual burnt-offering;
28.4: the one lamb you prepare in the morning, and the second lamb you prepare between the evenings;
28.5: and a tenth of the ephah of flour for a present, mixed with beaten oil, a fourth of the hin;
28.6: a continual burnt-offering, which was made in mount Sinai, for sweet fragrance, a fire-offering to Jehovah;
28.7: and its libation, a fourth of the hin for the one lamb; in the sanctuary cause you a libation of strong drink to be poured out to Jehovah.
28.8: `And the second lamb you do prepare between the evenings; as the present of the morning, and as its libation you prepare--a fire-offering, a sweet fragrance to Jehovah.
28.9: `And on the sabbath-day, two lambs, sons of a year, perfect ones, and two-tenth deals of flour, a present, mixed with oil, and its libation;
28.10: the burnt-offering of the sabbath in its sabbath, besides the continual burnt-offering and its libation.
28.11: `And in the beginnings of your months you bring near a burnt-offering to Jehovah: two bullocks, sons of the herd, and one ram, seven lambs, sons of a year, perfect ones;
28.12: and three-tenth deals of flour, a present, mixed with oil, for the one bullock, and two-tenth deals of flour, a present, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
28.13: and a several tenth deal of flour, a present, mixed with oil, for the one lamb; a burnt-offering, a sweet fragrance, a fire-offering to Jehovah;
28.14: and their libations are a half of the hin to a bullock, and a third of the hin to a ram, and a fourth of the hin to a lamb, of wine; this is the burnt-offering of every month for the months of the year;
28.15: and one kid of the goats for a sin-offering to Jehovah; besides the continual burnt-offering it is prepared, and its libation.
28.16: `And in the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, is the passover to Jehovah;
28.17: and in the fifteenth day of this month is a festival, seven days unleavened food is eaten;
28.18: in the first day is an holy convocation, you do no servile work,
28.19: and you have brought near a fire-offering, a burnt-offering to Jehovah: two bullocks, sons of the herd, and one ram, and seven lambs, sons of a year, perfect ones they are for you;
28.20: and their present, flour mixed with oil, three-tenth deals for a bullock, and two-tenth deals for a ram you do prepare;
28.21: a several tenth deal you prepare for the one lamb, for the seven lambs,
28.22: and one goat, a sin-offering, to make atonement for you.
28.23: `Apart from the burnt-offering of the morning, which is for the continual burnt-offering, you prepare these;
28.24: according to these you prepare daily, seven days, bread of a fire-offering, a sweet fragrance, to Jehovah; besides the continual burnt-offering it is prepared, and its libation;
28.25: and on the seventh day a holy convocation you have, you do no servile work.
28.26: `And in the day of the first-fruits, in your bringing near a new present to Jehovah, in your weeks, a holy convocation you have; you do no servile work;
28.27: and you have brought near a burnt-offering for sweet fragrance to Jehovah: two bullocks, sons of the herd, one ram, seven lambs, sons of a year,
28.28: and their present, flour mixed with oil, three-tenth deals to the one bullock, two-tenth deals to the one ram,
28.29: a several tenth deal to the one lamb, for the seven lambs;
28.30: one kid of the goats to make atonement for you;
28.31: apart from the continual burnt-offering and its present you prepare them (perfect ones they are for you) and their libations.

29.1: `And in the seventh month, in the first of the month, a holy convocation you have, you do no servile work; a day of shouting it is to you;
29.2: and you have prepared a burnt-offering, for sweet fragrance to Jehovah: one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, seven lambs, sons of a year, perfect ones;
29.3: and their present, flour mixed with oil, three-tenth deals for the bullock, two-tenth deals for the ram,
29.4: and one-tenth deal for the one lamb, for the seven lambs;
29.5: and one kid of the goats, a sin-offering, to make atonement for you;
29.6: apart from the burnt-offering of the month, and its present, and the continual burnt-offering, and its present, and their libations, according to their ordinance, for sweet fragrance, a fire-offering to Jehovah.
29.7: `And on the tenth of this seventh month a holy convocation you have, and you have humbled your souls; you do no work;
29.8: and you have brought near a burnt-offering to Jehovah, a sweet fragrance, one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, seven lambs, sons of a year, perfect ones they are for you,
29.9: and their present, flour mixed with oil, three-tenth deals for the bullock, two-tenth deals for the one ram,
29.10: a several tenth deal for the one lamb, for the seven lambs,
29.11: one kid of the goats, a sin-offering; apart from the sin-offering of the atonements, and the continual burnt-offering, and its present, and their libations.
29.12: `And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month a holy convocation you have; you do no servile work; and you have celebrated a festival to Jehovah seven days,
29.13: and have brought near a burnt-offering, a fire-offering, a sweet fragrance, to Jehovah; thirteen bullocks, sons of the herd, two rams, fourteen lambs, sons of a year; perfect ones they are;
29.14: and their present, flour mixed with oil, three-tenth deals to the one bullock, for the thirteen bullocks, two-tenth deals to the one ram, for the two rams,
29.15: and a several tenth deal to the one lamb, for the fourteen lambs,
29.16: and one kid of the goats, a sin-offering; apart from the continual burnt-offering, its present, and its libation.
29.17: `And on the second day twelve bullocks, sons of the herd, two rams, fourteen lambs, sons of a year, perfect ones;
29.18: and their present, and their libations, for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the sheep, in their number, according to the ordinance;
29.19: and one kid of the goats, a sin-offering; apart from the continual burnt-offering, and its present, and their libations.
29.20: `And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs, sons of a year, perfect ones;
29.21: and their present, and their libations, for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, in their number, according to the ordinance;
29.22: and one goat, a sin-offering; apart from the continual burnt-offering, and its present, and its libation.
29.23: `And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs, sons of a year, perfect ones;
29.24: their present, and their libations, for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, in their number, according to the ordinance;
29.25: and one kid of the goats, a sin-offering, apart from the continual burnt-offering, its present, and its libation.
29.26: `And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs, sons of a year, perfect ones;
29.27: and their present, and their libations, for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, in their number, according to the ordinance;
29.28: and one goat, a sin-offering; apart from the continual burnt-offering, and its present, and its libation.
29.29: `And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs, sons of a year, perfect ones;
29.30: and their present, and their libations, for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, in their number, according to the ordinance;
29.31: and one goat, a sin-offering; apart from the continual burnt-offering, its present, and its libation.
29.32: `And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs, sons of a year, perfect ones;
29.33: and their present, and their libations, for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, in their number, according to the ordinance;
29.34: and one goat, a sin-offering; apart from the continual burnt-offering, its present, and its libation.
29.35: `On the eighth day a restraint you have, you do no servile work;
29.36: and you have brought near a burnt-offering, a fire-offering, a sweet fragrance, to Jehovah; one bullock, one ram, seven lambs, sons of a year, perfect ones;
29.37: their present, and their libations, for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, in their number, according to the ordinance;
29.38: and one goat, a sin-offering; apart from the continual burnt-offering, and its present, and its libation.
29.39: `These you prepare to Jehovah in your appointed seasons, apart from your vows, and your free-will offerings, for your burnt-offerings, and for your presents, and for your libations, and for your peace-offerings.'
29.40: And Moses says to the sons of Israel according to all that Jehovah has commanded Moses.

30.1: And Moses speaks to the heads of the tribes of the sons of Israel, saying, `This is the thing which Jehovah has commanded:
30.2: `When a man vows a vow to Jehovah, or has sworn an oath to bind a bond on his soul, he does not pollute his word; according to all that is going out from his mouth he does.
30.3: `And when a woman vows a vow to Jehovah, and has bound a bond in the house of her father in her youth,
30.4: and her father has heard her vow, and her bond which she has bound on her soul, and her father has kept silent at her, then have all her vows been established, and every bond which she has bound on her soul is established.
30.5: `And if her father has disallowed her in the day of his hearing, none of her vows and her bonds which she has bound on her soul is established, and Jehovah is propitious to her, for her father has disallowed her.
30.6: `And if she be at all to a husband, and her vows are on her, or a wrongful utterance on her lips, which she has bound on her soul,
30.7: and her husband has heard, and in the day of his hearing, he has kept silent at her, then have her vows been established, and her bonds which she has bound on her soul are established.
30.8: `And if in the day of her husband's hearing he disallows her, then he has broken her vow which is on her, and the wrongful utterance of her lips which she has bound on her soul, and Jehovah is propitious to her.
30.9: `As to the vow of a widow or cast-out woman, all that she has bound on her soul is established on her.
30.10: `And if in the house of her husband she has vowed, or has bound a bond on her soul with an oath,
30.11: and her husband has heard, and has kept silent at her--he has not disallowed her--then have all her vows been established, and every bond which she has bound on her soul is established.
30.12: `And if her husband does certainly break them in the day of his hearing, none of the outgoing of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, is established--her husband has broken them--and Jehovah is propitious to her.
30.13: `Every vow and every oath--a bond to humble a soul--her husband does establish it, or her husband does break it;
30.14: and if her husband certainly keep silent at her, from day to day, then he has established all her vows, or all her bonds which are upon her; he has established them, for he has kept silent at her in the day of his hearing;
30.15: and if he does at all break them after his hearing, then he has borne her iniquity.'
30.16: These are the statutes which Jehovah has commanded Moses between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, in her youth, in the house of her father.

31.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
31.2: `Execute the vengeance of the sons of Israel against the Midianites--afterwards you are gathered to your people.'
31.3: And Moses speaks to the people, saying, `Be you armed some of you for the host, and they are against Midian, to put the vengeance of Jehovah on Midian;
31.4: a thousand for a tribe--a thousand for a tribe, to all the tribes of Israel--you do send to the host.'
31.5: And there are given out of the thousands of Israel a thousand for a tribe, twelve thousand armed ones of the host;
31.6: and Moses sends them, a thousand for a tribe, to the host, them and Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest, to the host; and the holy vessels, and the trumpets of the shouting, in his hand.
31.7: And they war against Midian, as Jehovah has commanded Moses, and slay every male;
31.8: and the kings of Midian they have slain, besides their pierced ones, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian; and Balaam son of Beor, they have slain with the sword.
31.9: And the sons of Israel take captive the women of Midian, and their infants; and all their cattle, and all their substance, and all their wealth they have plundered;
31.10: and all their cities, with their habitations, and all their towers, they have burnt with fire.
31.11: And they take all the spoil, and all the prey, among man and among beast;
31.12: and they bring in, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the company of the sons of Israel, the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, to the camp, to the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan, near Jericho.
31.13: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the company, go out to meet them, to the outside of the camp,
31.14: and Moses is wroth against the inspectors of the force, chiefs of the thousands, and chiefs of the hundreds, who are coming in from the host of the battle.
31.15: And Moses says to them, `Have you kept alive every female?
31.16: indeed, they--they have been to the sons of Israel, through the word of Balaam, to cause a trespass against Jehovah in the matter of Peor, and the plague is in the company of Jehovah.
31.17: `And now, slay you every male among the infants, yes, every woman known of man by the lying of a male you have slain;
31.18: and all the infants among the women, who have not known the lying of a male, you have kept alive for yourselves.
31.19: `And you, encamp you at the outside of the camp seven days--any who has slain a person, and any who has come against a pierced one, you cleanse yourselves on the third day, and on the seventh day--you and your captives;
31.20: and every garment, and every skin vessel, and every work of goats' hair, and every wooden vessel, you yourselves cleanse.'
31.21: And Eleazar the priest says to the men of the host who go in to battle, `This is the statute of the law which Jehovah has commanded Moses:
31.22: only, the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
31.23: every thing which may go into fire, you cause to pass over through fire, and it has been clean; only, with the water of separation it is cleansed, and all that may not go into fire, you cause to pass over through water;
31.24: and you have washed your garments on the seventh day, and have been clean, and afterwards you come in to the camp.'
31.25: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
31.26: `Take up the sum of the prey of the captives, among man and among beast, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers of the company;
31.27: and you have halved the prey between those handling the battle who go out to the host and all the company;
31.28: and you have raised a tribute to Jehovah from the men of war, who go out to the host, one body out of five hundred, of man, and of the herd, and of the asses, and of the flock;
31.29: from their half you do take, and you have given to Eleazar the priest--the heave-offering of Jehovah.
31.30: `And from the sons of Israel's half you do take one possession out of fifty, of man, of the herd, of the asses, and of the flock, of all the cattle, and you have given them to the Levites keeping the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah.'
31.31: And Moses does--Eleazar the priest also--as Jehovah has commanded Moses.
31.32: And the prey, the residue of the spoil which the people of the host have spoiled, is of the flock six hundred thousand, and seventy thousand, and five thousand;
31.33: and of the herd two and seventy thousand;
31.34: and of asses one and sixty thousand;
31.35: and of human beings--of the women who have not known the lying of a male--all the persons are two and thirty thousand.
31.36: And the half--the portion of those who go out into the host--the number of the flock is three hundred thousand, and thirty thousand, and seven thousand and five hundred.
31.37: And the tribute to Jehovah of the sheep is six hundred five and seventy;
31.38: and the herd is six and thirty thousand, and their tribute to Jehovah is two and seventy;
31.39: and the asses are thirty thousand and five hundred, and their tribute to Jehovah is one and sixty;
31.40: and the human beings are sixteen thousand, and their tribute to Jehovah is two and thirty persons.
31.41: And Moses gives the tribute--Jehovah's heave-offering--to Eleazar the priest, as Jehovah has commanded Moses.
31.42: And of the sons of Israel's half, which Moses halved from the men who war--
31.43: and the company's half is, of the flock three hundred thousand, and thirty thousand, seven thousand and five hundred;
31.44: and of the herd six and thirty thousand;
31.45: and of asses thirty thousand and five hundred;
31.46: and of human beings sixteen thousand--
31.47: Moses takes from the sons of Israel's half the one possession from the fifty, of man and of beast, and gives them to the Levites keeping the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah, as Jehovah has commanded Moses.
31.48: And the inspectors whom the thousands of the host has, (heads of the thousands and heads of the hundreds), draw near to Moses,
31.49: and they say to Moses, `Your servants have taken up the sum of the men of war who are with us, and not a man of us has been missed;
31.50: and we bring near Jehovah's offering, each that which he has found, vessels of gold--chain, and bracelet, seal-ring, ear -ring, and bead--to make atonement for ourselves before Jehovah.'
31.51: And Moses receives--Eleazar the priest also--the gold from them, every made vessel,
31.52: and all the gold of the heave-offering which they have lifted up to Jehovah is sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels, from heads of the thousands, and from heads of the hundreds;
31.53: (the men of the host have spoiled each for himself);
31.54: and Moses takes--Eleazar the priest also--the gold from the heads of the thousands and of the hundreds, and they bring it in to the tent of meeting--a memorial for the sons of Israel before Jehovah.

32.1: And much cattle has been to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad, very many; and they see the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, and indeed, the place is a place for cattle;
32.2: and the sons of Gad, and the sons of Reuben, come in and speak to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the company, saying:
32.3: `Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon--
32.4: the land which Jehovah has smitten before the company of Israel, is a land for cattle, and your servants have cattle.'
32.5: And they say, `If we have found grace in your eyes, let this land be given to your servants for a possession; cause us not to pass over the Jordan.'
32.6: And Moses says to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben, `Do your brethren go in to the battle, and you--do you sit here?
32.7: and why discourage you the heart of the sons of Israel from passing over to the land which Jehovah has given to them?
32.8: `Thus did your fathers in my sending them from Kadesh-Barnea to see the land;
32.9: and they go up to the valley of Eshcol, and see the land, and discourage the heart of the sons of Israel so as not to go in to the land which Jehovah has given to them;
32.10: and the anger of Jehovah burns in that day, and He swears, saying,
32.11: They do not see--the men who are coming up out of Egypt from a son of twenty years and upward--the ground which I have sworn to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, for they have not been fully after Me;
32.12: save Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua son of Nun, for they have been fully after Jehovah;
32.13: and the anger of Jehovah burns against Israel, and He causes them to wander in the wilderness forty years, until the consumption of all the generation which is doing the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah.
32.14: `And indeed, you have risen in the stead of your fathers, an increase of men--sinners, to add yet to the fury of the anger of Jehovah toward Israel;
32.15: when you turn back from after Him, then He has added yet to leave him in the wilderness, and you have done corruptly to all this people.'
32.16: And they come nigh to him, and say, `Folds for the flock we build for our cattle here, and cities for our infants;
32.17: and we--we are armed hasting before the sons of Israel till that we have brought them in to their place; and our infants have dwelt in the cities of defence because of the inhabitants of the land;
32.18: we do not turn back to our houses till the sons of Israel have inherited each his inheritance,
32.19: for we do not inherit with them beyond the Jordan and yonder, for our inheritance has come to us beyond the Jordan at the sun -rising.'
32.20: And Moses says to them, `If you do this thing: if you are armed before Jehovah for battle,
32.21: and every armed one of you has passed over the Jordan before Jehovah, till his dispossessing His enemies from before Him,
32.22: and the land has been subdued before Jehovah--then afterwards you do turn back, and have been acquitted by Jehovah, and by Israel; and this land has been to you for a possession before Jehovah.
32.23: `And if you do not so, indeed, you have sinned against Jehovah, and know you your sin, that it does find you;
32.24: build for yourselves cities for your infants, and folds for your flock, and that which is going out from your mouth do you.'
32.25: And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben speak to Moses, saying, `Your servants do as my lord is commanding;
32.26: our infants, our wives, our cattle, and all our beasts, are there in cities of Gilead,
32.27: and your servants pass over, every armed one of the host, before Jehovah, to battle, as my lord is saying.'
32.28: And Moses commands concerning them Eleazar the priest, and Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel;
32.29: and Moses says to them, `If the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben pass over with you the Jordan, every one armed for battle, before Jehovah, and the land has been subdued before you, then you have given to them the land of Gilead for a possession;
32.30: and if they do not pass over armed with you, then they have possessions in your midst in the land of Canaan.'
32.31: And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben answer, saying, `That which Jehovah has spoken to your servants--so we do;
32.32: we--we pass over armed before Jehovah to the land of Canaan, and with us is the possession of our inheritance beyond the Jordan.'
32.33: And Moses gives to them, to the sons of Gad, and to the sons of Reuben, and to the half of the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorite, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land by its cities, in the borders, the cities of the land round about.
32.34: And the sons of Gad build Dihon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
32.35: and Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
32.36: and Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-Haran, cities of defence, and sheepfolds.
32.37: And the sons of Reuben have build Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
32.38: and Nebo, and Baal-Meon (changed in name), and Shibmah, and they call by these names the names of the cities which they have built.
32.39: And sons of Machir son of Manasseh go to Gilead, and capture it, and dispossess the Amorite, who is in it;
32.40: and Moses gives Gilead to Machir son of Manasseh, and he dwells in it.
32.41: And Jair son of Manasseh has gone and captures their towns, and calls them `Towns of Jair;'
32.42: and Nobah has gone and captures Kenath, and its villages, and calls it Nobah, by his own name.

33.1: These are journeys of the sons of Israel who have come out of the land of Egypt, by their hosts, by the hand of Moses and Aaron;
33.2: and Moses writes their outgoings, by their journeys, by the command of Jehovah; and these are their journeys, by their outgoings:
33.3: And they journey from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month, on the morrow of the passover have the sons of Israel gone out with a high hand, before the eyes of all the Egyptians--
33.4: and the Egyptians are burying those whom Jehovah has smitten among them, every first-born, and on their gods has Jehovah done judgments--
33.5: and the sons of Israel journey from Rameses, and encamp in Succoth.
33.6: And they journey from Succoth, and encamp in Etham, which is in the extremity of the wilderness;
33.7: and they journey from Etham, and turn back on Pi-Hahiroth, which is on the front of Baal-Zephon, and they encamp before Migdol.
33.8: And they journey from Pi-Hahiroth, and pass over through the midst of the sea, into the wilderness, and go a journey of three days in the wilderness of Etham, and encamp in Marah.
33.9: And they journey from Marah, and come in to Elim, and in Elim are twelve fountains of waters, and seventy palm trees, and they encamp there;
33.10: and they journey from Elim, and encamp by the Red Sea.
33.11: And they journey from the Red Sea, and encamp in the wilderness of Sin;
33.12: and they journey from the wilderness of Sin, and encamp in Dophkah.
33.13: And they journey from Dophkah, and encamp in Alush;
33.14: and they journey from Alush, and encamp in Rephidim; and there was there no water for the people to drink.
33.15: And they journey from Rephidim, and encamp in the wilderness of Sinai;
33.16: and they journey from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamp in Kibroth-Hattaavah.
33.17: And they journey from Kibroth-Hattaavah, and encamp in Hazeroth;
33.18: and they journey from Hazeroth, and encamp in Rithmah.
33.19: And they journey from Rithmah, and encamp in Rimmon-Parez;
33.20: and they journey from Rimmon-Parez, and encamp in Libnah.
33.21: And they journey from Libnah, and encamp in Rissah;
33.22: and they journey from Rissah, and encamp in Kehelathah.
33.23: And they journey from Kehelathah, and encamp in mount Shapher;
33.24: and they journey from mount Shapher, and encamp in Haradah.
33.25: And they journey from Haradah, and encamp in Makheloth;
33.26: and they journey from Makheloth, and encamp in Tahath.
33.27: And they journey from Tahath, and encamp in Tarah;
33.28: and they journey from Tarah, and encamp in Mithcah.
33.29: And they journey from Mithcah, and encamp in Hashmonah;
33.30: and they journey from Hashmonah, and encamp in Moseroth.
33.31: And they journey from Moseroth, and encamp in Bene-Jaakan;
33.32: and they journey from Bene-Jaakan, and encamp at Hor-Hagidgad.
33.33: And they journey from Hor-Hagidgad, and encamp in Jotbathah;
33.34: and they journey from Jotbathah, and encamp in Ebronah.
33.35: And they journey from Ebronah, and encamp in Ezion-Gaber;
33.36: and they journey from Ezion-Gaber, and encamp in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
33.37: And they journey from Kadesh, and encamp in mount Hor, in the extremity of the land of Edom.
33.38: And Aaron the priest goes up to mount Hor, by the command of Jehovah, and dies there, in the fortieth year of the going out of the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first of the month;
33.39: and Aaron is a son of a hundred and twenty and three years in his dying in mount Hor.
33.40: And the Canaanite--king Arad--who is dwelling in the south, in the land of Canaan, hears of the coming of the sons of Israel.
33.41: And they journey from mount Hor, and encamp in Zalmonah;
33.42: and they journey from Zalmonah, and encamp in Punon.
33.43: And they journey from Punon, and encamp in Oboth;
33.44: and they journey from Oboth, and encamp in Ije-Abarim, in the border of Moab.
33.45: And they journey from Iim, and encamp in Dibon-Gad;
33.46: and they journey from Dibon-Gad, and encamp in Almon-Diblathaim.
33.47: And they journey from Almon-Diblathaim, and encamp in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo;
33.48: and they journey from the mountains of Abarim, and encamp in the plains of Moab, by Jordan, near Jericho.
33.49: And they encamp by the Jordan from Beth-Jeshimoth, to Abel-Shittim, in the plains of Moab.
33.50: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, in the plains of Moab, by Jordan, near Jericho, saying,
33.51: `Speak to the sons of Israel, and you have said to them, When you are passing over the Jordan to the land of Canaan,
33.52: then you have dispossessed all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and have destroyed all their imagery, yes, all their molten images you destroy, and all their high places you lay waste,
33.53: and you have possessed the land, and dwelt in it, for to you I have given the land--to possess it.
33.54: `And you have inherited the land by lot, by your families; to the many you increase their inheritance, and to the few you diminish their inheritance; where the lot goes out to him, it is his; by the tribes of your fathers you inherit.
33.55: `And if you do not dispossess the inhabitants of the land from before you, then it has been, those whom you let remain of them, are for pricks in your eyes, and for thorns in your sides, and they have distressed you on the land in which you are dwelling,
33.56: and it has come to pass, as I thought to do to them--I do to you.'

34.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
34.2: `Command the sons of Israel, and you have said to them, When you are coming in to the land of Canaan--this is the land which falls to you by inheritance, the land of Canaan, by its borders--
34.3: then has the south quarter been to you from the wilderness of Zin, by the sides of Edom, yes, the south border has been to you from the extremity of the Salt Sea, eastward;
34.4: and the border has turned round to you from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and has passed on to Zin, and its outgoings have been from the south to Kadesh-Barnea, and it has gone out at Hazar-Addar, and has passed on to Azmon;
34.5: and the border has turned round from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and its outgoings have been at the sea.
34.6: `As to the west border, even the great sea has been to you a border; this is to you the west border.
34.7: `And this is to you the north border: from the great sea you mark out for yourselves mount Hor;
34.8: from mount Hor you mark out to go in to Hamath, and the outgoings of the border have been to Zedad;
34.9: and the border has gone out to Ziphron, and its outgoings have been at Hazar-Enan; this is to you the north border.
34.10: `And you have marked out for yourselves for the border eastward, from Hazar-Enan to Shepham;
34.11: and the border has gone down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east of Ain, and the border has gone down, and has smitten against the shoulder of the sea of Chinnereth eastward;
34.12: and the border has gone down to the Jordan, and its outgoings have been at the Salt Sea; this is for you the land by its borders round about.'
34.13: And Moses commands the sons of Israel, saying, `This is the land which you inherit by lot, which Jehovah has commanded to give to the nine tribes and the half of the tribe;
34.14: for the tribe of the sons of Reuben have received, by the house of their fathers; and the tribe of the children of Gad, by the house of their fathers; and the half of the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance;
34.15: the two tribes and the half of the tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan, near Jericho, eastward, at the sun -rising.'
34.16: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
34.17: `These are the names of the men who give to you the inheritance of the land: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua son of Nun,
34.18: and one prince--one prince--for a tribe you do take to give the land by inheritance.
